research_question: Do lagged FTN process/scheme variables improve NFL winner-probability prediction after conditioning on market probability?
hypothesis: A compact, preregistered set of prior-game FTN process variables contains incremental team-state information beyond the market-conditioned baseline, with the strongest plausible contribution coming from changes in offensive process and pressure structure rather than raw descriptive volume.

source.license: CC-BY-SA-4.0; metadata only for technical qualification
source.availability_rule: A team-game aggregate is eligible for a simulated forecast only when every FTN row used by that aggregate has date_pulled no later than the simulated forecast decision timestamp. No row from the game being forecast may be used.
source.identity_rule: Join nflverse_game_id + nflverse_play_id to PBP game_id + play_id; require >=99.5% unambiguous join coverage before the experiment may run.

feature_construction.unit: team-game aggregates constructed only from previously completed games whose FTN rows passed the date_pulled availability gate
feature_construction.boolean_rate_denominator: For each boolean FTN field, take the arithmetic mean over non-null charted values for that team-game. Null values do not enter the denominator.
feature_construction.numeric_mean_denominator: For n_defense_box, n_blitzers and n_pass_rushers, take the arithmetic mean over non-null charted values for that team-game.
feature_construction.team_game_availability: The aggregate availability timestamp is the maximum date_pulled among FTN rows used by that team-game aggregate. An aggregate is ineligible if this timestamp is after the target decision time.
feature_construction.weighting: equal-weight rolling means across the most recent eligible team-games; no post-result selection of decay parameters
feature_construction.cross_season_history: allowed; the most recent eligible games may cross season boundaries because no offseason decay parameter is permitted in v1
feature_construction.change_features: For each rolling metric, include 3-game minus 6-game value only when both windows satisfy minimum history; otherwise mark missing rather than impute from future information.
feature_construction.matchup_encoding: For every 3-game, 6-game and 3-minus-6 metric, use home-team value minus away-team value. No cross-unit interactions are permitted in v1.
feature_construction.missingness: For each matchup feature, set an explicit missing indicator when either side is unavailable. Numeric missing values are imputed from training-fold medians only. If a numeric feature has no finite training-fold observations, fail the fold rather than invent an imputation value.

decision_clock.prior_game_rule: A source game must have scheduled kickoff strictly earlier than the target decision timestamp and may not share the target game_id.

benchmarks.primary: market-conditioned baseline using vig-free home probability from the historical nflverse schedule moneylines
benchmarks.primary_encoding: logit(market_home_prob) in a fixed-C logistic regression with intercept
benchmarks.market_alignment_gate: The schedule moneyline has no historical T-120 timestamp proof. Therefore FTN-PROCESS-01 is labeled a conservative historical market-conditioned benchmark screen, not a T-120 production simulation. No result may override this label.

model_family.primary: logistic regression on logit(market_home_prob) plus standardized continuous FTN matchup features and explicit missing indicators
model_family.ftn_scaling: For every fold, impute each FTN numeric feature with the training-fold median, then standardize using the training-fold mean and population standard deviation after imputation. Zero-variance features use scale=1. Missing indicators are not standardized.

chronology.rule: For each test season, fit only on eligible rows from earlier seasons; preprocessing statistics are fit inside the training fold only.
chronology.2025_role: last permitted prospective-style historical test season

stability: coefficient sign and magnitude by fold
metrics.uncertainty: stratified game-block bootstrap over held-out predictions

bootstrap.block: game_id row; each game is indivisible so both teams remain together
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of candidate-minus-baseline Brier differences

metrics.missingness: report coverage and metric behavior for complete vs missing-feature rows
ablations: interception-worthy and QB-fault-sack quality-control fields removed

decision_rule.qualify_for_shadow_candidate: Primary held-out Brier difference versus the market-conditioned baseline must be < 0, the 95% block-bootstrap upper bound for that difference must be < 0, aggregate log loss must not worsen, and no individual held-out season may worsen Brier by more than 0.010.
decision_rule.otherwise: Record as negative/inconclusive and do not rescue-tune FTN-PROCESS-01. A materially different follow-up requires a new preregistration.

prohibitions: No 2026 completed-game outcomes for feature/model/hyperparameter selection.
No manual feature removal or coefficient rescue after viewing held-out results.
No production promotion from this experiment alone.
No change to F-ST-01-FROZEN-2026 or the T-120 production lock.
